0022600017.text: The Detroit Pistons (4-1, first in the Central and the East) visit the Brooklyn Nets (0-4, 15th in the East), who have lost four straight and sit 3.5 games back in the Atlantic. Detroit is missing Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain), while Brooklyn is without Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain) and has Egor Demin listed as day-to-day with a leg bruise and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, though the Pistons won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 138-100 win in Brooklyn on March 10, 2026.
